## Task 2: Create 5 domain heuristic JSON files

Directory: D:/code/invesments/master_investments/data/training/domain-heuristics/

Check existing files for format reference (vn-cash-flow-operations.json), then create 5 new files. Each should have an array of heuristic objects with: id, domain, signal, implication, confidence, source.

### File 1: western-bootstrap-saas.json
Heuristics about SaaS bootstrapping reality:
- WBS-001: "30% of micro-SaaS never reach $1K MRR" (base rate)
- WBS-002: "67% of early-stage SaaS pivot or shut down within 18 months" (HubSpot 2024)
- WBS-003: "Vertical SaaS has 110-120% NRR vs horizontal 102-105%" (retention)
- WBS-004: "Median time to $1M ARR is 2 years 9 months" (timeline)
- WBS-005: "PLG dev tools can reach $1-3M ARR solo" (Plausible, Carrd examples)
- WBS-006: "Application SaaS under existential AI threat 2025-2026" (ServiceNow -40%)
- WBS-007: "Infrastructure software surviving AI disruption better than application layer"

### File 2: developer-tools.json
- DT-001: "Developer tools with PLG motion have lowest CAC in B2B"
- DT-002: "Open source + hosted model sustainable for solo founders"
- DT-003: "Micro-niche dev tools grew 340% vs broad platforms" (Gartner Q4 2025)
- DT-004: "No aggregate dev tools success rate exists — survivorship bias in case studies"
- DT-005: "Integration/glue tools create high switching costs after 12 months"

### File 3: b2b-data-services.json
- BDS-001: "Business data decays 30% annually — perpetual demand" (LinkedIn)
- BDS-002: "Contact data decays 22.5% per year" (structural recurring need)
- BDS-003: "85% of profitable AI startups controlled proprietary datasets" (Bessemer 2025)
- BDS-004: "DaaS moat comes from quality/freshness process not data exclusivity"
- BDS-005: "GDPR-style regulation is primary existential risk for data businesses"

### File 4: embedded-fintech.json
- EF-001: "Embedded fintech transactions to exceed $7T by end 2026" (FIS/Bain)
- EF-002: "SaaS + embedded fintech = 2-5x revenue per customer uplift" (Bain)
- EF-003: "Requires partnership with licensed financial institution"
- EF-004: "Transactional revenue scales non-linearly with customer volume"
- EF-005: "Regulatory moat protects against casual competitors"

### File 5: ai-augmented-services.json
- AAS-001: "85-92% of generic AI wrappers fail within 5 years" (Market Clarity 2025)
- AAS-002: "Vertical AI in regulated industries grew 340% vs generic wrappers" (Gartner)
- AAS-003: "AI-augmented service = human judgment + AI speed, not pure automation"
- AAS-004: "Must continuously move up complexity chain as AI improves"
- AAS-005: "Proprietary training data from service delivery creates compound moat"

For each file, use this format (match existing files):
```json
[
  {
    "id": "WBS-001",
    "domain": "western-bootstrap-saas",
    "signal": "30% of micro-SaaS never reach $1K MRR",
    "implication": "Base rate failure is high; most micro-SaaS die before meaningful revenue",
    "confidence": 0.75,
    "source": "SaaSRanger 2025, 1000+ products surveyed",
    "tags": ["base_rate", "failure_pattern", "micro_saas"]
  }
]
```
